purpose: Local model-name overlay review using exact-model real product photography and a measured shared label system

style.placement: Every visible glyph layer is trimmed, proportionally fit to the same exterior-panel safe boxes, and centered at the same x coordinate. Main lines share one top and size cap; qualifiers share one top, width, and height cap. Source compositions are proportionally normalized to the same 2000 x 2500 canvas.

records.overlayPlacementRule: shared measured exterior safe box; main line only
transformations: white-canvas trim and proportional scale normalization
